now: Magneto opens his orbiting haven to mutants, but Fabian Cortez seizes it, captures and tortures Gambit, and fires missiles at Earth.
proposed: Fabian Cortez takes over Magneto's orbiting haven and fires hundreds of missiles at Earth, until Magneto returns and destroys both the missiles and the asteroid.
changes.evidence: Episode 49 is Sanctuary Part II. Magneto offering Asteroid M to mutants and Cortez forcing him out in an escape pod happen in Part I (episode 48). In Part II Cortez runs the asteroid and sends missiles at Earth, Rogue looks for the missing Gambit, and Magneto comes back to destroy the missiles and the asteroid. Both the Wikipedia list and the Marvel Database pages (Season 4 6 and 7) say so.

owner_calls.question: Spider-Man (1994)#18 (Mutants' Revenge): the entry puts Rogue flirting with Spider-Man and Wolverine joining his hunt at the mansion, but the full synopsis has Spider-Man only in Manhattan. Wolverine meets him there, they raid Landon's building, and the X-Men fly in by Blackbird. The mansion shows up only as the War Room. No source mentions Rogue flirting. Spider-Man's visit to the mansion is episode 17, which already has an entry. What to do with this entry?
options: Drop the entry from the mansion (the team-up belongs on the New York pin)
Rewrite it to a mansion event once one is confirmed on screen
owner_calls.evidence: Marvel Database 'Spider-Man: The Animated Series Season 2 5' full synopsis: Spider-Man and Wolverine fight and team up outside and inside Landon's building in Manhattan, and the X-Men arrive in the Blackbird. Its locations list Xavier's School only through the War Room. Season 2 4 (episode 17) is the mansion visit.

owner_calls.question: Venom: Let There Be Carnage's San Quentin execution sits as a spot inside the San Francisco pin, but San Quentin is in unincorporated Marin County, north of San Francisco across the bay (about 37.94, -122.49). Keep it under San Francisco as a Bay Area spot, or give it its own place?
options: Make San Quentin its own place at 37.939, -122.489 (Marin County, California)
owner_calls.evidence: Wikipedia: San Quentin Rehabilitation Center (formerly San Quentin State Prison) is located north of San Francisco in unincorporated Marin County, on Point San Quentin on the north side of San Francisco Bay.
